fixture.description: Fixture name identifying the fixture project under fixtures-src/. The first character must be ASCII alphanumeric; the remainder admits the canonical [A-Za-z0-9._@-] set plus a single-byte space and Latin-1 letters (U+00C0-U+00FF) so hostile-path aliases validate; control characters (tab/newline) are rejected by the pattern. HOSTILE ALIAS CONVENTION: a fixture value that is not a canonical fixtures-src/ directory (contains a space or a non-ASCII character) is an alias — bin/tt-fixture-provision.mjs resolves the alias to its canonical fixture for golden-bare and fixture-source lookups while the work clone path keeps the manifest name verbatim (W1.X1: 'tt-ts café' resolves to tt-ts). Alias values are reserved and deliberately authored, never ad-hoc.

seed.description: OPTIONAL immutable seed git ref the working fixture clone should land on. Holds a ref NAME (e.g. 'BUG-P1' or 'seed/storm' or 'broken-tests'), never a 'refs/...' prefix: the provisioning stage resolves a bare name by checking it out directly as given, and resolves a branch-style name (no 'seed/' prefix) onto the working clone's current branch. A seed ref reproduces the case's exact starting tree (green base + exactly one seeded defect) per spec 02-fixture-projects.md green-base + seed-ref discipline. Absent or null => provision from the fixture's green baseline.

test_cmd.description: RAW test command the workflow actually runs in this fixture — passed to the harness as --context test_cmd=<value> and fed into launchGateKey (O2/O9/O10 evidence); never a pre-wrapped shim invocation. Per-fixture canonical commands: tt-python and tt-python@master use .venv/bin/pytest -q; tt-ts uses npm test; tt-poly-lite uses ./run-all-tests. Verify against the fixture/workflow config before authoring — never guess.

requires.description: CANONICAL HOST-ADAPTATION CONTRACT (predicates). Every entry is evaluated against the host capability profile emitted by W0.0 (tt-verify-environment) as host-profile.json. A predicate that the host cannot satisfy gates the case to outcome NOT_RUN (predicate) with evidence — it is never silently skipped and never a failure. See tamandua-torture-test-spec/01-environment-and-isolation.md and oracles/CONTRACT.md (host-adaptation note) for the single authoritative contract; every representation here MUST agree with the profile's real key names or the case drifts.

toolchains.description: CANONICAL CONTRACT: an ARRAY of toolchain names; each name is SATISFIED iff the host profile records `toolchains.<name>.present === true` (a Boolean leaf) using the profile's REAL key names (python3, node, go, rust/cargo, java+maven). buildPassed/testPassed (W0.0's --fast probes leave them null) are NOT required for a predicate to be satisfied. A missing/inactive toolchain gates the case NOT_RUN (predicate) with expected true / observed evidence — never silently skipped.

capabilities.description: CANONICAL CONTRACT: harness capabilities `pi` and `hermes` map to harness PRESENCE recorded in the host profile (harness.<name>.present Boolean leaf; spec 01 makes pi/hermes operator-preconfigured, so W0.0 RECORDS mechanical presence, never installs). Any other capability name is resolved against the profile per the same Boolean-leaf rule. An honestly-present capability must NOT be gated; an honestly-absent capability gates the case NOT_RUN (predicate) with expected/observed evidence.
